text: what model are you even looking at lol? [Image #2] [Image #3] do you see why this is problematic. I literally can only make out one side of the head and not the other without uding vert/face/edge overlays
resolution: Diagnosed the one-side-reads-one-side-doesn't asymmetry from the user's two HEAD_ONE screenshots: the old shading was world-anchored (one fixed sun diagonal), so the side of the head facing the sun showed facets while the far side collapsed to flat ambient; also owned that my earlier demo used a library asset, not the user's model. The matcap (9fd84db53) is camera-anchored — the shading ramp always spans whatever faces the viewport — so every orbit angle reads equally. User restarted their dev host onto the new build and confirmed live on HEAD_ONE: the previously featureless side view now shows full faceting with warm/cool separation. User's words: 'yeah thats much better'.
